nodes.label: Signed Feed Configuration
nodes.rationale: Approval compiles settings into a signed feed configuration that Glue jobs read; drafts and hand-edited bundles are refused so only approved config reaches the data plane.

nodes.label: Schema-Drift Pre-Flight
nodes.rationale: Blocks a batch before any row loads when required or high-risk SSE fields would break; rename/date-format fixes become draft mapping versions for SME approval.

nodes.label: Control Plane vs Glue Data Plane Split
nodes.rationale: Every byte of loan data is parsed, mapped, validated and loaded inside Glue; Lambdas only register files, route, report and serve the API so the control plane never transforms or loads loan data.
nodes.norm_label: control plane vs glue data plane split

nodes.label: HMAC-SHA256 Tamper-Evident Config Bundles
nodes.rationale: Each bundle carries SHA-256 of canonical JSON plus HMAC; hand-edited, truncated or stale bundles are refused and audited as batch.config_rejected.

nodes.label: Live Safety Switches Outside Bundle
nodes.rationale: T1 kill switch, auto-suspension and vendor suspended status are read from the database at run time, not from the signed bundle, so they act on the next row.

nodes.label: Same lbp Wheel Everywhere
nodes.rationale: The lbp wheel is installed into every Glue job; tests, local worker and Glue all run the same mapping, rule and triage code.

nodes.label: Reject Glue Python Shell Runtime
nodes.rationale: Glue Python shell supports only Python 3.9; lbp needs 3.11 or later, so jobs use Glue 5.0 Python/Spark instead.

nodes.label: Optimistic Concurrency via lbp_version
nodes.rationale: Write only changed fields under optimistic concurrency; if version moved since delta was computed, rebase; conflicts become CHG05.

nodes.label: Snapshot Truncation Guard
nodes.rationale: If more than max_missing_pct (default 5%) of the vendor portfolio is absent, treat as truncated: no CHG04 reviews, flag batch and alert; SME can raise reviews after vendor check.

nodes.label: Delivery Scheduler
nodes.rationale: File arrival stays event-driven; the scheduler watches deadlines and pulls for vendors that don't push, and never delays processing.
